shortDescription: Canada's main stock index opened higher on Friday, as stronger gold and copper prices lifted mining stocks, while firmer oil prices drove gains in the energy sector.The S&P/TSX Composite Index TSX:TSX was up 0.94% at 34,750.74 points at 9:31 a.m. ET (1431 GMT).
